row.title: EXEC-STUB-GUARD-1 and GATE-STUB-1: a gutted existing file is refused on the Actions route and at the gate
row.body: 2026-11-20: pull request 725 answered Q-GATE-403 by replacing the 150-line seed/worker/src/worker-gate.js with seventeen lines around an elision marker; the model review approved it. NATIVE-STUB-1 (727) guards new files written by the Worker-native executor only. The Actions executor now refuses an answer that holds an elision or logic-here placeholder or cuts an existing file to under half, before anything is written, and the Worker gate fails any agent, claude or worker branch whose added lines hold such a placeholder.
